title: Tenant note CRUD
description: Create, edit, and delete tenant notes (COMPLAINT/DAMAGE/GENERAL) with an occurredOn date independent of createdAt/updatedAt, plus an optional photo.
acceptanceCriteria: Note occurredOn can be set in the past
Editing and deleting an existing note both work
Deleting is a hard delete (no undo required)

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Building alongside LODGY-25 (timeline view) - CRUD and the timeline are one screen pair, matching the wireframes. Reusing LODGY-11's PhotoPickerField for the optional note photo. Correction from initial plan: TenantProfileScreen had no 'Notes & timeline' link yet (it was dead in the sense of not existing) - adding it now as part of this ticket, next to the existing 'Checkout tenant' card.

Built TenantNoteRepository (data/repository/TenantNoteRepository.kt: create/update/delete/getByTenantId/getById over TenantNoteDao), NoteFormViewModel/NoteFormScreen (ui/note/NoteFormForm*.kt) with type filter chips for COMPLAINT/DAMAGE/GENERAL, a text field, an occurredOn date picker (unrestricted, so past dates work - AC1), and PhotoPickerField reused as-is for the optional photo. Editing an existing note pre-fills all fields from TenantNoteRepository.getById and shows a delete icon in the top bar with an AlertDialog confirm ('This can't be undone') - AC2 (edit/delete both work) and AC3 (hard delete, no undo) both hold: delete calls TenantNoteDao.delete directly, no soft-delete flag anywhere in the schema. Added the 'Notes & timeline' entry point to TenantProfileScreen.kt (a new Card between the detail card and the checkout action) and wired NOTES_TIMELINE_ROUTE/NOTE_FORM_ROUTE into LodgyNavHost.kt. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass still queued - same emulator/adb limitation noted on every ticket this session; worth checking camera vs gallery photo capture on a note, and that editing occurredOn on a note (LODGY-25's AC2) visibly moves it in the timeline.
